modal.title: Settings
modal.description: Manage your profile, notifications, preferences and security.

avatar.formats: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF (saved as WebP).
avatar.tooLarge: That image is too big. The maximum size is 15 MB.
avatar.loadFailed: Couldn't load that image. Try a JPG or PNG.

username.label: Username
username.description: What should we call you? It has to be unique.

acquisition.label: How did you hear about Disscount?
acquisition.description: It helps us find more people like you.

notifications.hint: Choose how, about what and when you want to hear about offers and news.

push.label: Allow app notifications
push.description: The mobile app only notifies you about offers on products you choose. No spam.

email.label: Allow email notifications
email.description: You'll get emails about offers only on products you choose. No spam.

newsletter.label: News and updates
newsletter.description: Occasional Disscount news by email. No spam.

feedback.label: Feedback contact
feedback.description: Let us get in touch to ask for your feedback on the app.

language.label: Language
language.hint: The language of the app and the emails we send you.
language.locked: Save or reset your changes first, then switch language.

save.offline: You're offline. Changes will sync when you're back online.

validation.usernameMin: Username must be at least 2 characters
validation.usernameMax: Username can be at most 40 characters

onboarding.fallbackDescription: A quick account setup. You can change everything later.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: Introduce yourself. You can change everything later in settings.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose how, about what and when you want to hear about offers and news.

preferences.title: Your stores and locations
preferences.description: Pick the stores and places near you for more accurate price comparisons.

welcome.intro: A few quick steps will set Disscount up for you. You can change everything later in settings.

profile.title: Make your profile yours
profile.text: Add your name and an avatar to make the app your own.

stores.title: Your stores
stores.text: Pick the stores and locations near you so price comparisons fit your budget.

notifications.title: Notifications without spam
notifications.text: Choose how, about what and when you want to hear about offers and news.

done.title: Disscount is ready for you.
done.text: Select Finish to save your choices. You can change everything later in your account settings.

credentials.label: Sign-in and password
credentials.hintWithPassword: Confirm your current password to change your email or password.
credentials.hintWithoutPassword: Set a password so you can also sign in with your email, not only with a social account.
credentials.emailLockedSocial: To change your email, first unlink your connected social accounts.
credentials.emailLockedNoPassword: You'll be able to change your email once you've set a password.
credentials.newPasswordPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep your current one
credentials.currentPasswordDescription: Needed to confirm an email or password change.

submit.passwordSet: Password set! You can now also sign in with your email.
submit.socialLinked: To change your email, first unlink your connected accounts (Google, Facebook).
submit.passwordChangedConfirmEmail: Password changed. To change your email, confirm the link we sent to your current address.
submit.emailConfirmationSent: We sent a confirmation link to your current email address. Your email changes once you confirm it.
submit.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.

recovery.title: Check your email
recovery.description: We sent you a link to change your password. After you change it, we'll sign you out on all devices.
recovery.sendFailed: Couldn't send the link. Try again.

linked.label: Linked accounts
linked.hint: Link social accounts to sign in faster.

actions.revokeDescription: Ends every active session except this one.
actions.deleteDescription: Permanently deletes your account and all related data.
actions.revokeDialogDescription: Every active session except this one will be ended.
actions.deleteDialogDescription: Your account and all related data will be permanently deleted.
actions.revokeFailed: Couldn't sign out of other devices.
actions.revoked: Signed out of all other devices.
actions.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete your account. Try again.
